diagnostics.message: The collection things has the id parameter id and no singular, so its operation ids read getId and createId.
diagnostics.fix: Set singular on the collection (the noun of its operation ids), or name its id parameter with the noun, as in productId.

diagnostics.message: The item Note of the collection things has no property id to hold the member id.
diagnostics.fix: Set idProperty to the item property that holds the id, or add that property to the item.
